card: Resets the bump fee discount when clearing selected coins in SelectionResult and adds a unit test. SelectionResult::Clear() dropped selected inputs but left their bump fee discount behind, causing GetTotalBumpFees() to subtract the discount from zero and report negative bump fees. The wallet currently avoids triggering this bug only because Clear() is called prior to applying discounts in the knapsack solver.
evidence: PR description: "SelectionResult::Clear() removes the selected inputs but keeps their bump fee discount. GetTotalBumpFees() then subtracts that discount from zero, so any positive discount gives the empty selection a negative fee total. The wallet currently avoids this because it only clears selections inside the knapsack solver, before applying the discount."
Commit 4ce6b53149: "The discount accounts for shared ancestors of the selected inputs. Once those inputs are gone, subtracting their discount gives the empty selection a negative bump fee total."
problem: SelectionResult::Clear() empties selected inputs but leaves their ancestor bump fee discount intact. When GetTotalBumpFees() is called on the emptied selection, it subtracts the remaining discount from zero, yielding a negative bump fee. The existing codebase avoids this in practice only because Clear() is currently invoked before discounts are calculated.

risk.why: A mistake in coin selection state reset logic could miscalculate bump fees or affect coin selection results during wallet transaction creation.

scope_notes: A very small 4-line patch across wallet coin selection logic and unit tests.
summary: Resets the bump fee discount when clearing a SelectionResult in the wallet coin selection code. It also adds a unit test verifying that bump fees do not evaluate to a negative total after clearing a selection.
